newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Re to buy rest of Uniorias from INA.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Re to buy rest of Uniorias from INA.

text.p: Swiss Reinsurance Co. said on Wednesday it planned to purchase the remaining 51 percent of Unione di Riassicurazione SpA (Uniorias) that it did not own from Istituto Nazionale delle Assicurazoni SpA (INA) as part of its plan to strengthen its presence in Italy.
Uniorias is the leading reinsurer in Italy and Swiss Re has already acquired 49 percent in it.
Swiss Re said in a statement that it planned to complete the acquisition of the remaining 51 percent during 1997.

Uniorias will fully concentrate on Italy's life and non-life reinsurance market and bring together under one roof the porfolios currently managed in Italy by Uniorias, La Consorziale, Mercantile & General Re and Swiss Re.
Outside Italy, Swiss Re will represent Uniorias.
Swiss Re said it had appointed Andreas Beerli as managing director of its Italian operations and Antonio Solari as new general manager.
